evidence.reason: At lines 720-721 the ladder returns 'terminated' as soon as child.close resolves. That close promise tracks the leader's close event, not every member of the process group; a descendant that ignores SIGTERM and redirects stdio can outlive the leader while the SIGKILL rung at line 726 is skipped. The implementation can therefore report termination while leaving a governed descendant alive. This is an existing-behavior correctness bug; group cleanup must be tracked separately from leader closure.
